# hg help

**What this page tells you:** every `hg help` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Full flags and subcommands for one command.

## Synopsis

```text
hg help [<command>]
```

## Description

`hg help <command>` and `hg <command> --help` print the same thing. `hg help` prints the command list.
